name: N8N-Automation-Suite
headline: Twenty MCP Server - AI CRM Integration Toolkit
short_description: The twenty-mcp-server is an AI-powered toolkit designed for integration with the Twenty CRM API. It simplifies CRM operations, enhancing productivity and enabling efficient data management for sales teams.
author: oumnya

sections.overview:
The twenty-mcp-server is an AI-powered toolkit that integrates with the Twenty CRM API to streamline customer relationship management operations. It simplifies CRM workflows and enables efficient data management, helping sales teams work more productively. By connecting AI capabilities to Twenty CRM, this skill automates routine tasks and improves operational efficiency for sales-focused teams.
Automating CRM data entry
Integrating CRM with other tools
Enhancing sales workflows
Generating sales reports
sections.usage:
```
Act as a Twenty CRM expert. I need to [ACTION] with [DATA] in my Twenty CRM account. Use the Twenty CRM API to [ACTION]. Provide step-by-step instructions and any relevant code snippets.
```
